title: Magento Frontend Developer
description:
Magento Frontend Developer

**Pay:** ₹20,000 – ₹60,000 a month  
**Experience:** 2–5 years

**About the role:** Create fast, engaging, and responsive storefronts on Magento 2.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and customize Magento 2 themes and UI components
* Convert designs into pixel-perfect, responsive pages
* Work with layout XML, PHTML, LESS/CSS, and JavaScript
* Collaborate with designers and backend developers

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years of Magento 2 frontend experience
* Strong HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, and KnockoutJS
* Knowledge of RequireJS and responsive design
* Familiarity with Hyvä or PWA is a plus

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
